# CG-SCHEMA-002: Schema representation changed (equivalent)

The schema is spelled differently but means the same.

**Why it matters:** Reported only on request, for review.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.representationChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Representation of {where} changed ({what}) without changing its meaning.
>
> Validation behaviour is unchanged.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: 3.0 nullable → 3.1 type array

With options: `{"includeEquivalentChanges":true}`

```diff
- openapi: 3.0.3
+ openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Representation of GET /x: response 200 (application/json) changed (nullability (oas30-nullable → type-includes-null)) without changing its meaning.

### Does not fire: not requested

```diff
- openapi: 3.0.3
+ openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
